note: Formal experiment registry (MASTER_PLAN 38). Entries are append-only; results are never overwritten. Namespaces: experiments/<EXP-ID>-<slug>/ holds result.json + report.md only; bulk artifacts are git-ignored runtime outputs.

experiments.title: Phase 1 quantization baseline: reference implementation latency, memory, representation size
experiments.config: uniform quantization L in {8,16,32,64,128,256} x {320x240, 640x480, 1920x1080}, synthetic gradient scene, seed 0, 8 warm-up + 22 measured frames per condition
key_findings: quantization latency is independent of L (~7.5 ms at 1080p for all level counts)
quantized map = 1/3 of raw RGB bytes; float64 luminance intermediate = 8/3 (reported cost)
grayscale float64 conversion dominates pipeline cost; optimization deferred to Phase 8 per plan 3.14

experiments.title: Phase 2 intensity-object extraction: cost of labeling, identity and metadata
experiments.config: vie.objects-config/1 reference (connectivity 4, min_area 1 unless stated); 3 sizes x 4 scenes x L in {8,16,64,256} (5 measured frames + 2 warm-up each) plus a dense per-pixel-noise block at L=256 (320x240 and 640x480 min_area=1, 1920x1080 min_area=2)
key_findings: structured 1080p extraction p50 106-148 ms (2 regions); ramp_bands (one-pixel-wide runs) is the main-matrix worst case at 2.33 s/frame
label maps are int32 = 4 bytes/pixel (4/3 of the uint8 intensity map, 4/9 of raw RGB) - reported, not hidden
dense-noise metadata dominates: 13.3 MB/frame at 320x240 and 53.9 MB/frame at 640x480, ~58x the raw frame; min_area is the lever (discards counted)
latency must be measured untraced: tracemalloc inflates this code 1.36x-16x (measured)
fully dense 1920x1080 noise at min_area=1 (~2.07M records) exceeded 3 GB and is recorded as not measured
experiments.decision: Phase 2 accepted (DEC-0004) on this evidence; optimization deferred to the profiling phase (plan 3.14/8), no rate claimed

experiments.title: Phase-1 baseline re-measurement (untraced latency) for incremental Phase-2 cost comparison
experiments.config: same 18 conditions as EXP-0001 (L in {8,16,32,64,128,256} x {320x240,640x480,1920x1080}, gradient, 6 warm-up + 18 measured frames) measured with latency UNTRACED and the memory peak in a separate untimed pass
key_findings: tracemalloc timing inflation for the Phase-1 stages is small (ratios ~1.0-1.2; up to 1.58x for the allocation-light quantization at 1080p), unlike the 1.36x-16x measured for object extraction
EXP-0001's conclusions (quantization ~L-independent; grayscale dominates) hold, but incremental-cost arithmetic must use EXP-0003 because EXP-0001 timed with tracing active
experiments.decision: supersedes EXP-0001 for latency comparisons only; EXP-0001 artifacts and its memory measurements remain as recorded

experiments.title: min_area sensitivity on dense per-pixel noise (640x480, L=256)
experiments.config: static scene with every pixel randomized (noise_px=307200, L=256), min_area in {1,2,4,8,16}; identical frames across conditions, only the filter changes; 1 warm-up + 3 measured frames
key_findings: kept regions per frame: 227,660 (min_area=1) -> 18,528 (2) -> 9,071 (4) -> 3,538 (8) -> 877 (16); all discards counted (dropped_regions/dropped_pixels)
extraction p50: 2338 ms (min_area=1) -> 229 (2) -> 125 (4) -> 74 (8) -> 49 ms (16); region-metadata bytes: 53.9 MB -> 4.5 -> 2.2 -> 0.9 -> 0.2 MB (58.5x -> 0.2x of raw RGB)
cost is dominated by kept-region bookkeeping, not frame size: record construction is 69.5% of extraction at min_area=1 but 11.4% at min_area=16
min_area is therefore a scientific lever on both noise policy and cost; the baseline remains min_area=1 for accuracy questions
experiments.decision: threshold sweep recorded; no default change (baseline stays min_area=1, drops always counted)

experiments.title: Phase-2 stage split: labeling vs record construction (untraced latency)
experiments.config: gradient and ramp_bands scenes at 640x480 and 1920x1080, L in {16,64}, 2 warm-up + 5 measured frames; extraction timed as labeling (components + label map) plus record construction (records + fingerprints), both untraced
key_findings: for structured scenes, labeling dominates extraction: 98-99.9% (e.g. 1920x1080 ramp_bands L=64: 2291 ms extract = 2279 labeling + 12 records)
record construction only dominates when enormous numbers of regions are kept (EXP-0004: 69.5% at 227,660 kept regions)
extraction totals cross-check against EXP-0002 within run-to-run variance on this 2-CPU host (ratios 0.97-1.18 for the 8 overlapping conditions)
experiments.decision: stage split instrumented by the runner (labeling_ns/records_ns) instead of inferred; totals remain comparable with EXP-0002
